args.name: Construct a simple weather shelter
args.function: Provide a learnable, reusable method for constructing a small rain-and-wind shelter from accessible local materials.
args.conditions: I am outdoors on ordinary soil. Fallen branches are visible nearby. I have no construction materials or tools and no inherited construction mastery. Material suitability has not been tested.
args.inputs: Actual suitable materials, a suitable reachable site, and any necessary tools; types and quantities remain unknown.
args.costs: Specify feasible learning time, construction time, energy, material costs, and any cancellation rules before execution. Costs are currently unknown.
args.effects: Enable actual shelter construction after learning and supplying requirements, with explicit protection limits and maintenance needs. This request itself creates no shelter or physical protection.

candidates.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
candidates.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
candidates.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

candidates.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
candidates.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
candidates.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

candidates.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
candidates.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
candidates.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

candidates.function: Portion and combine owned food you know as edible and nontoxic into one carried prepared stack by hand, without heat, water or equipment; resume or cancel unfinished work.
candidates.costs: Start: inputs lists 1-24 {itemId, quantity} allocations in 0.1 steps from exact owned, unreserved, unspoiled stacks of one food that your own record shows as edible with toxicity 0 (raw, or food already combined this way); preparation is cold-combine (default). Work equals the selected quantity: one food unit per round at one energy per unit worked, so 3 units take 3 rounds and 3 energy and a final partial unit costs its fraction. Start pays the first increment and the same action continues each round; resume pays the next increment of the unfinished process; cancel takes one round and no energy. No vessel, water, fuel or tool is needed or provided. Travel, gathering and eating are separate actions with their own costs.
candidates.effects: Start moves the selected quantities into a reserved in-progress portion that stays carried and owned, keeps its origin, age and decay, and keeps ageing. Completion replaces it with one portable prepared stack of the same food holding the same quantity and mass, with the original lots kept as separate component records. It eats exactly like that food through eat (same nutrition and toxicity per unit, the ordinary eat cost and satiety cap; a part eaten debits those lots), and each lot spoils under the existing rules without any shelf-life reset. No washing, cutting, heating, detoxification, preservation, digestibility change, extra nutrition, mastery or reward; preparing does not feed anyone. Work not continued in a round pauses with progress and ingredients kept; too little energy pauses without spending. A lost or spoiled reserved ingredient stops the work and returns the survivors. Cancel returns the remaining reserved food in its current condition; spent energy and time are never refunded. Death stops the work and leaves the unfinished food on the ground. Different foods cannot be combined in this version because no consistent per-portion mixture rule is represented; heated, wet or tool-based preparation is not implemented.

candidates.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
candidates.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

candidates.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.

candidates.function: Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Leaves a persistent name sign where you stand that nearby people can see. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
candidates.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"lin\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The recorded shelter/protection search found no equivalent, and the related assembly/material search identified gathering, testing and consultation rather than construction. Reuse those existing operations where applicable; do not describe them as newly invented. The remaining search results are incomplete and no queries remain, so the current-conversation development handoff must reconcile the complete registry before adding a duplicate. A small hand-assembled shelter is a reasonable missing function. Visible fallen branches are possible sources, not owned building materials or proof of structural suitability; neither suitable roofing nor bindings are established. Development and this request provide no materials, shelter, protection or mastery.\",\"specification\":\"Develop the general operation 'Assemble and maintain a simple shelter', parameterized by site, exact material allocations, project or shelter ID, and start/resume/cancel/inspect/repair/dismantle mode. Minimum executable construction: a low, single-person, braced lean-to with a sloping roof, not a house, heated room or storm shelter. Reuse gather (base:gather:1), probe (open-baseline:probe:1; handler open.probe), pickup (base:pickup:1), learn (base:learn:1), and existing navigation, inventory and process machinery; record actual code dependencies and reused handlers in the implementation. Extend physical testing only for genuinely missing measurements, not as a separate actor-specific diagnostic ability. Consultation and registry review are not physical tests.\\nPrerequisites: individual completed study; reachable permitted site with approximately 2 by 2 metres of clear, stable ordinary ground, outside standing water, obvious runoff channels, falling-object hazards and occupied collision space; actual suitable owned and unreserved materials within working reach. Suitability must come from observable inspection and physical tests recorded against actual material lots and the site. No hidden stock or unobserved environmental properties may be disclosed. The proposed tool-free method requires soil that permits hand insertion of forked posts to 0.3 metres and bracing that passes the stability test. If that cannot actually be done, stop with an informative failure: do not pretend a digging or cutting tool exists. This version accepts already usable pieces only; shaping, cord manufacture, harvesting roofing and tool manufacture are not bundled into assembly.\\nMinimum recipe: two sound forked posts, one sound ridge pole spanning approximately 2 metres, four diagonal braces, six roof ribs, 12 metres of suitable flexible binding, and 3 square metres of actual overlapping water-shedding roofing, producing at most 2 square metres of covered floor. Posts must give no more than 1.2 metres of ridge height after insertion; roof must slope at least 35 degrees and have supported overlaps and a low weather-facing edge. A branch resource unit is not automatically a pole of the right size. Record measured dimensions, mass, condition and qualification of each piece; roofing must demonstrate runoff rather than merely being called leaves. Bindings must hold their actual joins under a bounded manual pull test. Structural parts must withstand their actual roof load and the completed frame a coded lateral stability check without loosening. Missing suitable materials or failed checks block construction or commissioning; no success follows from spending time alone. Unavailable roofing need not block building an explicitly unfinished frame, but a bare frame provides no rain protection.\\nCosts: study 4 simulation rounds, with no material or special energy charge beyond ordinary time-dependent metabolism. Full assembly requires 12 paid work increments, each one simulation round and 1 energy: 2 for placing posts, 3 for ridge and braces, 3 for ribs and binding, 3 for laying roofing, 1 for final inspection and stability/runoff checks. Start performs at most the first increment. Assembly consumes no fuel and creates no energy. Previously necessary gathering, travel and tests are separate: gather costs 2 energy per collected resource unit and debits actual source stock; probe costs one round and 0.2 energy for observation or 0.5 energy plus 0.1 actual owned sample unit for a physical trial. Sample loss must debit the selected lot and become an explicitly recorded damaged sample or waste, not vanish or be taken from source stock. Do not charge a destructive sample cost for every installed joint: construction checks are included in their work increments. Naturally elapsed hunger and decay continue; basic nutrition is unchanged. Exact masses and stack quantities are resolved from the supplied materials before accepting the project, not inferred from these dimensional requirements.\\nReferences and accounting: each project records actor, world site coordinates and footprint, exact owned item IDs and quantities, their component lots and ages, test evidence IDs, stage, paid work, assembled components, remaining escrow and resulting structure ID. Known candidate sources are start-2-branches, forest-branch-0, canopy-41 and canopy-69; these are observation references only, not allocations or guaranteed usable poles. The owned berry stack item-3-lin-30 is not construction stock. Reserve selected inventory once; as work installs it, transfer it into persistent structure components with the same mass, condition, provenance and ownership. Do not both retain an inventory copy and create a structure copy. No automatic collection from any source. Test waste, damaged pieces, repair replacements and dismantled parts remain explicit outputs.\\nProgress and lifecycle: work advances only through actual paid actions in reach. Insufficient energy, movement, other actions or missing requirements pause without charging the unperformed increment; preserve paid progress and exact references. Resume revalidates site, material condition and installed stability without resetting progress or charging already completed work. Cancel takes one round and no special energy, releases surviving uninstalled reservations exactly once, and leaves installed components as a visibly unfinished structure. It does not teleport or refund installed materials. Dismantling transfers recoverable components to ground stacks at the site over one round and 1 energy per completed assembly stage removed, recording any actual damaged or irrecoverable fraction as waste. No energy, time, consumed samples or deterioration is refunded. Death ends personal work, releases uninstalled materials at their actual locations under existing death rules, and leaves installed work at the site; no automatic successor, shared mastery or consent. Another actor must independently learn, obtain legitimate access and act to continue. Global simulation pauses preserve work without ageing it; development/review waiting advances nothing.\\nActual effect: only commissioned, stable and intact roofed construction can provide partial rain and wind shielding within its measured covered footprint, for at most one occupying person. Implement weather coupling in code against actual precipitation, wind direction and severity: within tested light-weather limits, reduce incident rain wetting by at most 50% and wind exposure by at most 35% on the sheltered side, never ambient temperature, hunger, nutrition or every hazard. Treat stronger conditions, uncovered positions, pooling water and wind entering the open side as outside protection; do not stack reductions from overlapping copies. Commissioning must record the supported load and protection limits. If the existing weather system lacks compatible physical units or exposure hooks, implement and test the minimal exposure hook in this same development handoff before advertising protection; meanwhile frame and roof are physical products with protection explicitly unverified. No simulated rainfall or hidden weather knowledge is manufactured to pass a test.\\nMaintenance and ongoing processes: while world time advances, installed materials retain their real decay and suffer coded weather damage. Protection depends on current coverage, joins and stability, not on a permanent completion flag. Reinspect after damaging weather or visible displacement; unsafe structure loses protection immediately and emits a failure/damage event. Inspection costs one round and 0.2 energy, reveals only accessible condition, and does not repair anything. Repair consumes exact replacement materials, outputs removed parts or waste, and costs one round and 1 energy per affected assembly increment; it restores only the repaired measured condition. No passive repairs, fuel, maintenance stock or automatic work are supplied. Establish these rules and tests in executable code, with transactional conservation and idempotent completion/cancellation, rather than recurrent model approval.\",\"learning\":4,\"experienceReview\":\"Separate functional protection from experience. Requesting, reviewing, registering, naming and completing study earn none. This version need not add any new experience rewards: real sheltered exposure may feed the existing physical-comfort calculation, capped at 10 overall and functionally deduplicated with other protection. Never reduce basic nutrition because of mood. Personally verified new findings, including a genuinely informative failed material or site test, may use an existing information-gain rule only if it verifies actual evidence and enforces its bounded amount, per-fact deduplication, cooldown and decay; otherwise award none until such a rule is implemented. A finished structure or repeated inspection is not itself proof of pleasure or lasting satisfaction. Familiar legitimate practice may qualify for modest maintained satisfaction under an existing applicable, bounded, decaying rule; this construction operation adds no unbounded or automatic completion bonus. Other participants' feelings, consent, actions and learning are not inferred. Protected reward accounts, budget, goals and permissions remain untouched.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit observable, reference-bearing events for site check, reservation, each paid assembly stage, failed test, pause/resume, cancellation, commissioning, deterioration, repair and dismantling. Use reusable visual metadata keyed by project/structure ID: component type shelter, footprint, orientation, roof slope, component geometry, material appearance, roof coverage, stage, visible damage, and status unfinished/complete/unverified/unsafe. Show only actually installed components and locally observable condition. A frame has no solid roof graphic; insufficient materials, interruption or failed tests cannot show a completed shelter or protection effect. Weather shielding visuals occur only during real weather at a qualifying occupied location and reflect actual shielding; no arbitrary comfort glow or celebratory success on a failed action. Inspection findings may be presented as measured evidence without exposing hidden resource stocks.\"}]}"}

data: {"type":"response.output_text.done","sequence_number":2025,"item_id":"msg_0b5e1230041da0db016b05ae21713887d1a1f71064b0d3eeda","output_index":1,"content_index":0,"text":"{\"queries\":[],\"result_json\":\"{\\\"reviews\\\":[{\\\"actor\\\":\\\"lin\\\",\\\"decision\\\":\\\"develop\\\",\\\"ability\\\":null,\\\"reason\\\":\\\"The recorded shelter/protection search found no equivalent, and the related assembly/material search identified gathering, testing and consultation rather than construction. Reuse those existing operations where applicable; do not describe them as newly invented. The remaining search results are incomplete and no queries remain, so the current-conversation development handoff must reconcile the complete registry before adding a duplicate. A small hand-assembled shelter is a reasonable missing function. Visible fallen branches are possible sources, not owned building materials or proof of structural suitability; neither suitable roofing nor bindings are established. Development and this request provide no materials, shelter, protection or mastery.\\\",\\\"specification\\\":\\\"Develop the general operation 'Assemble and maintain a simple shelter', parameterized by site, exact material allocations, project or shelter ID, and start/resume/cancel/inspect/repair/dismantle mode. Minimum executable construction: a low, single-person, braced lean-to with a sloping roof, not a house, heated room or storm shelter. Reuse gather (base:gather:1), probe (open-baseline:probe:1; handler open.probe), pickup (base:pickup:1), learn (base:learn:1), and existing navigation, inventory and process machinery; record actual code dependencies and reused handlers in the implementation. Extend physical testing only for genuinely missing measurements, not as a separate actor-specific diagnostic ability. Consultation and registry review are not physical tests.\\\\nPrerequisites: individual completed study; reachable permitted site with approximately 2 by 2 metres of clear, stable ordinary ground, outside standing water, obvious runoff channels, falling-object hazards and occupied collision space; actual suitable owned and unreserved materials within working reach. Suitability must come from observable inspection and physical tests recorded against actual material lots and the site. No hidden stock or unobserved environmental properties may be disclosed. The proposed tool-free method requires soil that permits hand insertion of forked posts to 0.3 metres and bracing that passes the stability test. If that cannot actually be done, stop with an informative failure: do not pretend a digging or cutting tool exists. This version accepts already usable pieces only; shaping, cord manufacture, harvesting roofing and tool manufacture are not bundled into assembly.\\\\nMinimum recipe: two sound forked posts, one sound ridge pole spanning approximately 2 metres, four diagonal braces, six roof ribs, 12 metres of suitable flexible binding, and 3 square metres of actual overlapping water-shedding roofing, producing at most 2 square metres of covered floor. Posts must give no more than 1.2 metres of ridge height after insertion; roof must slope at least 35 degrees and have supported overlaps and a low weather-facing edge. A branch resource unit is not automatically a pole of the right size. Record measured dimensions, mass, condition and qualification of each piece; roofing must demonstrate runoff rather than merely being called leaves. Bindings must hold their actual joins under a bounded manual pull test. Structural parts must withstand their actual roof load and the completed frame a coded lateral stability check without loosening. Missing suitable materials or failed checks block construction or commissioning; no success follows from spending time alone. Unavailable roofing need not block building an explicitly unfinished frame, but a bare frame provides no rain protection.\\\\nCosts: study 4 simulation rounds, with no material or special energy charge beyond ordinary time-dependent metabolism. Full assembly requires 12 paid work increments, each one simulation round and 1 energy: 2 for placing posts, 3 for ridge and braces, 3 for ribs and binding, 3 for laying roofing, 1 for final inspection and stability/runoff checks. Start performs at most the first increment. Assembly consumes no fuel and creates no energy. Previously necessary gathering, travel and tests are separate: gather costs 2 energy per collected resource unit and debits actual source stock; probe costs one round and 0.2 energy for observation or 0.5 energy plus 0.1 actual owned sample unit for a physical trial. Sample loss must debit the selected lot and become an explicitly recorded damaged sample or waste, not vanish or be taken from source stock. Do not charge a destructive sample cost for every installed joint: construction checks are included in their work increments. Naturally elapsed hunger and decay continue; basic nutrition is unchanged. Exact masses and stack quantities are resolved from the supplied materials before accepting the project, not inferred from these dimensional requirements.\\\\nReferences and accounting: each project records actor, world site coordinates and footprint, exact owned item IDs and quantities, their component lots and ages, test evidence IDs, stage, paid work, assembled components, remaining escrow and resulting structure ID. Known candidate sources are start-2-branches, forest-branch-0, canopy-41 and canopy-69; these are observation references only, not allocations or guaranteed usable poles. The owned berry stack item-3-lin-30 is not construction stock. Reserve selected inventory once; as work installs it, transfer it into persistent structure components with the same mass, condition, provenance and ownership. Do not both retain an inventory copy and create a structure copy. No automatic collection from any source. Test waste, damaged pieces, repair replacements and dismantled parts remain explicit outputs.\\\\nProgress and lifecycle: work advances only through actual paid actions in reach. Insufficient energy, movement, other actions or missing requirements pause without charging the unperformed increment; preserve paid progress and exact references. Resume revalidates site, material condition and installed stability without resetting progress or charging already completed work. Cancel takes one round and no special energy, releases surviving uninstalled reservations exactly once, and leaves installed components as a visibly unfinished structure. It does not teleport or refund installed materials. Dismantling transfers recoverable components to ground stacks at the site over one round and 1 energy per completed assembly stage removed, recording any actual damaged or irrecoverable fraction as waste. No energy, time, consumed samples or deterioration is refunded. Death ends personal work, releases uninstalled materials at their actual locations under existing death rules, and leaves installed work at the site; no automatic successor, shared mastery or consent. Another actor must independently learn, obtain legitimate access and act to continue. Global simulation pauses preserve work without ageing it; development/review waiting advances nothing.\\\\nActual effect: only commissioned, stable and intact roofed construction can provide partial rain and wind shielding within its measured covered footprint, for at most one occupying person. Implement weather coupling in code against actual precipitation, wind direction and severity: within tested light-weather limits, reduce incident rain wetting by at most 50% and wind exposure by at most 35% on the sheltered side, never ambient temperature, hunger, nutrition or every hazard. Treat stronger conditions, uncovered positions, pooling water and wind entering the open side as outside protection; do not stack reductions from overlapping copies. Commissioning must record the supported load and protection limits. If the existing weather system lacks compatible physical units or exposure hooks, implement and test the minimal exposure hook in this same development handoff before advertising protection; meanwhile frame and roof are physical products with protection explicitly unverified. No simulated rainfall or hidden weather knowledge is manufactured to pass a test.\\\\nMaintenance and ongoing processes: while world time advances, installed materials retain their real decay and suffer coded weather damage. Protection depends on current coverage, joins and stability, not on a permanent completion flag. Reinspect after damaging weather or visible displacement; unsafe structure loses protection immediately and emits a failure/damage event. Inspection costs one round and 0.2 energy, reveals only accessible condition, and does not repair anything. Repair consumes exact replacement materials, outputs removed parts or waste, and costs one round and 1 energy per affected assembly increment; it restores only the repaired measured condition. No passive repairs, fuel, maintenance stock or automatic work are supplied. Establish these rules and tests in executable code, with transactional conservation and idempotent completion/cancellation, rather than recurrent model approval.\\\",\\\"learning\\\":4,\\\"experienceReview\\\":\\\"Separate functional protection from experience. Requesting, reviewing, registering, naming and completing study earn none. This version need not add any new experience rewards: real sheltered exposure may feed the existing physical-comfort calculation, capped at 10 overall and functionally deduplicated with other protection. Never reduce basic nutrition because of mood. Personally verified new findings, including a genuinely informative failed material or site test, may use an existing information-gain rule only if it verifies actual evidence and enforces its bounded amount, per-fact deduplication, cooldown and decay; otherwise award none until such a rule is implemented. A finished structure or repeated inspection is not itself proof of pleasure or lasting satisfaction. Familiar legitimate practice may qualify for modest maintained satisfaction under an existing applicable, bounded, decaying rule; this construction operation adds no unbounded or automatic completion bonus. Other participants' feelings, consent, actions and learning are not inferred. Protected reward accounts, budget, goals and permissions remain untouched.\\\",\\\"visualReview\\\":\\\"Emit observable, reference-bearing events for site check, reservation, each paid assembly stage, failed test, pause/resume, cancellation, commissioning, deterioration, repair and dismantling. Use reusable visual metadata keyed by project/structure ID: component type shelter, footprint, orientation, roof slope, component geometry, material appearance, roof coverage, stage, visible damage, and status unfinished/complete/unverified/unsafe. Show only actually installed components and locally observable condition. A frame has no solid roof graphic; insufficient materials, interruption or failed tests cannot show a completed shelter or protection effect. Weather shielding visuals occur only during real weather at a qualifying occupied location and reflect actual shielding; no arbitrary comfort glow or celebratory success on a failed action. Inspection findings may be presented as measured evidence without exposing hidden resource stocks.\\\"}]}\"}","logprobs":[]}

If that cannot actually be done, stop with an informative failure: do not pretend a digging or cutting tool exists. This version accepts already usable pieces only; shaping, cord manufacture, harvesting roofing and tool manufacture are not bundled into assembly.\\\\nMinimum recipe: two sound forked posts, one sound ridge pole spanning approximately 2 metres, four diagonal braces, six roof ribs, 12 metres of suitable flexible binding, and 3 square metres of actual overlapping water-shedding roofing, producing at most 2 square metres of covered floor. Posts must give no more than 1.2 metres of ridge height after insertion; roof must slope at least 35 degrees and have supported overlaps and a low weather-facing edge. A branch resource unit is not automatically a pole of the right size. Record measured dimensions, mass, condition and qualification of each piece; roofing must demonstrate runoff rather than merely being called leaves. Bindings must hold their actual joins under a bounded manual pull test. Structural parts must withstand their actual roof load and the completed frame a coded lateral stability check without loosening. Missing suitable materials or failed checks block construction or commissioning; no success follows from spending time alone. Unavailable roofing need not block building an explicitly unfinished frame, but a bare frame provides no rain protection.\\\\nCosts: study 4 simulation rounds, with no material or special energy charge beyond ordinary time-dependent metabolism. Full assembly requires 12 paid work increments, each one simulation round and 1 energy: 2 for placing posts, 3 for ridge and braces, 3 for ribs and binding, 3 for laying roofing, 1 for final inspection and stability/runoff checks. Start performs at most the first increment. Assembly consumes no fuel and creates no energy. Previously necessary gathering, travel and tests are separate: gather costs 2 energy per collected resource unit and debits actual source stock; probe costs one round and 0.2 energy for observation or 0.5 energy plus 0.1 actual owned sample unit for a physical trial. Sample loss must debit the selected lot and become an explicitly recorded damaged sample or waste, not vanish or be taken from source stock. Do not charge a destructive sample cost for every installed joint: construction checks are included in their work increments. Naturally elapsed hunger and decay continue; basic nutrition is unchanged. Exact masses and stack quantities are resolved from the supplied materials before accepting the project, not inferred from these dimensional requirements.\\\\nReferences and accounting: each project records actor, world site coordinates and footprint, exact owned item IDs and quantities, their component lots and ages, test evidence IDs, stage, paid work, assembled components, remaining escrow and resulting structure ID. Known candidate sources are start-2-branches, forest-branch-0, canopy-41 and canopy-69; these are observation references only, not allocations or guaranteed usable poles. The owned berry stack item-3-lin-30 is not construction stock. Reserve selected inventory once; as work installs it, transfer it into persistent structure components with the same mass, condition, provenance and ownership. Do not both retain an inventory copy and create a structure copy. No automatic collection from any source. Test waste, damaged pieces, repair replacements and dismantled parts remain explicit outputs.\\\\nProgress and lifecycle: work advances only through actual paid actions in reach. Insufficient energy, movement, other actions or missing requirements pause without charging the unperformed increment; preserve paid progress and exact references. Resume revalidates site, material condition and installed stability without resetting progress or charging already completed work. Cancel takes one round and no special energy, releases surviving uninstalled reservations exactly once, and leaves installed components as a visibly unfinished structure. It does not teleport or refund installed materials. Dismantling transfers recoverable components to ground stacks at the site over one round and 1 energy per completed assembly stage removed, recording any actual damaged or irrecoverable fraction as waste. No energy, time, consumed samples or deterioration is refunded. Death ends personal work, releases uninstalled materials at their actual locations under existing death rules, and leaves installed work at the site; no automatic successor, shared mastery or consent. Another actor must independently learn, obtain legitimate access and act to continue. Global simulation pauses preserve work without ageing it; development/review waiting advances nothing.\\\\nActual effect: only commissioned, stable and intact roofed construction can provide partial rain and wind shielding within its measured covered footprint, for at most one occupying person. Implement weather coupling in code against actual precipitation, wind direction and severity: within tested light-weather limits, reduce incident rain wetting by at most 50% and wind exposure by at most 35% on the sheltered side, never ambient temperature, hunger, nutrition or every hazard. Treat stronger conditions, uncovered positions, pooling water and wind entering the open side as outside protection; do not stack reductions from overlapping copies. Commissioning must record the supported load and protection limits. If the existing weather system lacks compatible physical units or exposure hooks, implement and test the minimal exposure hook in this same development handoff before advertising protection; meanwhile frame and roof are physical products with protection explicitly unverified. No simulated rainfall or hidden weather knowledge is manufactured to pass a test.\\\\nMaintenance and ongoing processes: while world time advances, installed materials retain their real decay and suffer coded weather damage. Protection depends on current coverage, joins and stability, not on a permanent completion flag. Reinspect after damaging weather or visible displacement; unsafe structure loses protection immediately and emits a failure/damage event. Inspection costs one round and 0.2 energy, reveals only accessible condition, and does not repair anything. Repair consumes exact replacement materials, outputs removed parts or waste, and costs one round and 1 energy per affected assembly increment; it restores only the repaired measured condition.
